relationship_verifications.time_lag: minimal (< 30s) consistent with CSTR residence time
relationship_verifications.state_dependence: Pressure moderates slope at p < 3.0 bar

mechanism_chains.claim: Temperature increase accelerates the rate-limiting step of the main reaction pathway
mechanism_chains.data_support: Strong: global r=0.72, detrended r=0.68, effect persists after confound control
mechanism_chains.diagnosis_support: Consistent with baseline diagnosis of activation energy barrier limitation
competing_explanations: Temperature artifact from sensor drift (excluded by change-point test)
mechanism_chains.what_would_change_conclusion: Evidence that temperature effect vanishes under controlled randomization OR evidence that the measured correlation is entirely sensor artifact

competing_explanations.explanation: Temperature-yield correlation is an artifact of co-varying feedstock quality
competing_explanations.support_level: Weak - feedstock quality was constant during observation window
against: Partial correlation controlling for feedstock remains significant

evidence_gaps.gap: No direct measurement of activation energy from independent experiments
evidence_gaps.impact_on_conclusions: Cannot independently confirm the Arrhenius mechanism beyond correlation
evidence_gaps.mitigation: Recommend lab-scale kinetic study at 3 temperature levels
